en: The image features a sepia-toned photograph of a single, tall, ancient column standing on a large stone base. The scene includes some large agave plants in the foreground, a fence, and what appears to be tombs or ruins nearby. There is a tree on the right side and distant hills under a partly cloudy sky. The overall style and wear suggest it is an old postcard. The text 'www.elia.org.gr' is visible at the bottom.
